  MIN(mi_idx.info) AS rating,
  MIN(t.title) AS western_violent_movie

  INNER JOIN info_type it1 ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id AND it1.info = 'countries'

  INNER JOIN movie_companies mc ON mc.movie_id = t.id

    AND mc.note NOT LIKE '%(USA)%' 
    AND mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
  INNER JOIN movie_info mi ON mi.movie_id = t.id

    AND mi_idx.info < '7.0'
  INNER JOIN title t ON t.id = mc.movie_id
